name: save_skill
description: Save a new Agent Skill to your prompts.chat account. Skills are multi-file prompts that can include SKILL.md (required), reference docs, scripts, and configuration files. Requires API key authentication. If the file contents are too long, first save the SKILL.md only, with no other files. Then call add_file_to_skill tool per file.

description.description: Description of what the skill does

files.description: Array of files. Must include SKILL.md as the main skill file.

isPrivate.description: Whether the skill is private (default: uses your account setting)
